title: GDLM 69 time hop
desc: A ride through time: a new era in a new colour on every phrase.
journey: A ride through time: each phrase of the song is a new era in a new colour, the middle falls into a dark void between eras, and the end hops eras faster and faster until the ship flies out.
oneImage: The whole screen switching colour on a phrase start, as if the time machine just jumped.
never: deco that competes with the path (the look is the colours, not objects)
speed changes (the song's steady 143 BPM is the clock)
a long flying part before the middle

feel.density: about one hazard per block, two in the ship parts

camera: plain: the camera follows the player, no zoom or shake; the colours do all the telling
motifs: a palette switch on a phrase start = a jump to a new era (instant when hopping, a 10 s fade when sinking into or out of the void)
upside-down cube moments as short 'the world turned over' interludes
flipped screen (mirror) once time runs backwards

vehicle.why: on foot before the machine starts

beats.moment: a short upside-down hop at 4 s: a taste of the world turning

vehicle.why: the rhythm of the machine: jumps on the beat

beats.moment: the first jump in time: the screen turns blue

beats.place: a pink era where time runs backwards

vehicle.why: the ship is the hardest early stretch: the machine takes off

beats.moment: the screen flips (mirror) and turns pink; a ship at 34 s

beats.mood: quiet, lost, slow fade to black

vehicle.why: back on foot, finding the way in the dark

beats.moment: a 10 s fade to near black

vehicle.why: the world turns over as the machine restarts

beats.moment: a 10 s fade up from black into purple

beats.place: pink, green, cyan, magenta, green: an era every few seconds

vehicle.why: the colours move fast, the cube keeps its feet so the player can watch them

beats.moment: an instant palette switch every 3-7 s, flipped and upside-down moments between

vehicle.why: the machine flies out of time

beats.moment: ship, then upside-down ship to the end
